messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about International politics and organisations, Conflict, security and peace, Government, political systems and organisations, and Economic systems and development in Germany during the 1980s, matching this research need: Survey data on West Germans’ Cold War security attitudes: perceptions of the USA versus USSR, economic and military strength, values, foreign policy alignment, Andropov leadership change, news consumption, party sympathy, and demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
